evidence.detail: !stillbugged and !notbugged appear only as user-facing footer text, not as command handlers — they are MTGO in-game commands, not Discord commands
Only one match: the footer string in modobug.py; no implementation in this repo
PDBot hosted at pdbot.pennydreadfulmagic.com — separate service; !stillbugged is handled inside PDBot's command parser, not here

triage.notes: The !stillbugged command's case-sensitive card name matching is inside PDBot's MTGO command handler, which is not in this repository. A fix would require normalizing the card name (e.g., lowercasing both sides of the comparison) in PDBot's command parsing code. This repo has no lever to change that behavior.
